description.value: Pizza 2001 is a downtown Vancouver institution that has been hand-crafting stone-baked pizzas for over 25 years, using dough made fresh daily and premium ingredients sliced in-store. It's a small corner spot well-known for its slice counter, making it a quick and filling stop for cyclists passing through the heart of the city. The business uses traditional deck ovens and has built a loyal following for consistent, generously topped pizzas.
